people.name: Abijah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Jeshanah
people.line: A town captured by Abijah from Jeroboam

translations.web: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
translations.bsb: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and captured some cities from him: Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, along with their villages.
translations.kjv: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
translations.asv: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephron with the towns thereof.
